# QS-CFW-7189-64 - Quality specification - bearing ring CFW-7189-64 (52100)

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1  
Parts: CFW-7189-64

## Scope
This quality specification applies to bearing ring CFW-7189-64 (CFW-7189-64) manufactured from 52100 material at Plant P1. It defines acceptance criteria, inspection methods, and nonconformance handling for forged, heat treated, and finished rings.

## Requirements
| Characteristic | Requirement | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hardness | The hardness range for bearing ring CFW-7189-64 (CFW-7189-64) is 24-29 HRC. | Rockwell C scale on cross-section per sampling plan. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for bearing ring CFW-7189-64 (CFW-7189-64) is ±0.04 mm. | Measure at specified inspection locations. |
| Forging weight | The maximum forging weight for bearing ring CFW-7189-64 (CFW-7189-64) is 22.9 kg. | Applies to single-piece forgings prior to finish machining. |

## Inspection method
- Visual: Inspect for surface discontinuities, laps, cracks, and material defects. Use standard plant lighting and magnification aids as required.
- Dimensional: Verify bore diameter at production hold points using calibrated bore gauges or micrometers. Record measurements against the bore diameter tolerance for bearing ring CFW-7189-64 (CFW-7189-64) is ±0.04 mm.
- Hardness: Verify hardness by testing on cross-sectioned samples or finished parts using a calibrated Rockwell C tester. Confirm the hardness range for bearing ring CFW-7189-64 (CFW-7189-64) is 24-29 HRC.
- Weight: Confirm forging weight does not exceed the maximum forging weight for bearing ring CFW-7189-64 (CFW-7189-64) is 22.9 kg at the forging release point. Use calibrated scales and retain weight records with batch traceability.

All inspection equipment must be calibrated and traceable. Record inspection results in the electronic quality record for the part.

## Nonconformance handling
- Segregate and tag any part failing to meet the requirements table.
- Assess disposition by Quality Engineering. Options include rework, scrap, or return to vendor per standard procedures.
- For dimensional or hardness nonconformance, document root cause and corrective action in the nonconformance report. Retain records with the part lot until closure.
